notes.title: Final update before official launch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/a8c93e6745bb4d2502a041030f249d2770472db7.png

Homebased team is bringing some great news and answers to all your questions!

First of all we would like to say big thanks to all our active community members. Small things like answering other player's questions, sharing information and your very own strategies really helped us to stay focused on game development. Apes together - STRONG.


All information is down here

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1253710/announcements/detail/2998814003935349141

Thank you for all your patience and support! It's been a long journey for Garbage!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.notes:
We reduced the usage of RAM even more.
Also fixed several bugs.

Hope this will improve your gaming experience!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.notes:
We had been informed that there was memory usage issues so we are launching a hotfix.
The memory usage was decreased by 50% and now there should be less issues launching the game on Garbage Pc's.
